name: voxelgame
description: Minecraft-style voxel engine and map editor with 0.5m and 1m voxels. Runs offline from a single index.html.

scripts.build: npm run build:worker && npm run build:editor && npm run build:game
scripts.build:worker: esbuild src/engine/meshWorkerMain.js --bundle --format=iife --outfile=build/mesh-worker.js --sourcemap --banner:js='/* bundle generated by esbuild — do not edit by hand */'
scripts.build:editor: esbuild src/main.js --bundle --format=iife --outfile=build/game.js --sourcemap --banner:js='/* bundle generated by esbuild — do not edit by hand */'
scripts.build:game: node tools/pack_splash.mjs && esbuild src/game/gameMain.js --bundle --format=iife --outfile=build/game-play.js --sourcemap --banner:js='/* bundle generated by esbuild — do not edit by hand */'
